name: a Supersedes whose old statement is live, which the insert retracts in the same commit

uql: insert Claim { id: "CLM:old", statement: "the router is up" }
insert Claim { id: "CLM:new", statement: "the router is down" }
insert Supersedes { new: Claim(id = "CLM:new"), old: Claim(id = "CLM:old") }
